- Timeline (target):

  - Redwood completes entitlement configuration + CPPO creation: 2 business days after PO received.
  - AWS CPPO approval + activation in marketplace: 1–3 business days (depends on AWS SLA).
  - End-to-end expected: 4–6 business days from PO.

- Co-sell pre-reqs:
  - Reseller must be registered as an AWS reseller and have a valid AWS Marketplace seller account (screenshot of partner registry helps).
  - Basic partner profile (billing contact, tax info, public listing name) — checklist has fields.

Adding a couple of billing/entitlement notes: 

- Billing contact: whoever signs the PO should be set as the billing contact in our system; but we can accept an invoice contact separate from the signer if needed.
- Pricing entitlements: CPPOs allow a committed discount tiering; to enable usage-based discounts we need the SKU mapping (I've attached a snippet in the checklist).
- Tax/VAT: For EU or APAC deals we route to finance templates; for US customers the standard Redwood reseller addendum applies.

Action for ResellCo: please attach the PO PDF and the reseller registration screenshot. I'll pre-stage the entitlement config as soon as we have the PO.
